proves.claim: next --stuck releases the held claim as BLOCKED with the note and claims another item in the same call.

cli.io-commands-next.stuck-releases-and-.why: Without it a stuck builder needs a release and a second next, and an agent's whole loop is not one command.

proves.claim: next --stuck with no held claim or an empty reason is refused USAGE and changes nothing.

cli.io-commands-next.stuck-needs-a-claim.why: Without it a bare flag could release nothing or record a release with no reason.

proves.claim: next.js has no static import of packages/landing; the four landing helpers are sync wrappers over one call-time load of the landing front door.

cli.io-commands-next.landing-loads-at-ca.why: Without it a static landing import loads the landing barrel when the module loads, and the later guard slice has no one-file seam to build on.
